intro: Fits anywhere, feels great everywhere. With a common shell and multiple base options, Shine seamlessly moves between training rooms, cafés, and home offices—because one chair should do it all.

features.title: Where design meets functionality
features.text: The petal-inspired shell creates a pleasing visual when grouped together, with a smooth, rib-free back for a clean and modern look.

features.title: Comfort and safety you can trust
features.text: With a wraparound contour and tapered back profile, you get ample lower back support and safe, sharp-edge-free design—so you can sit comfortably and move freely.

features.title: Easy to grab, easy to move
features.text: The intuitive grab zone at the top offers comfortable lifting without pressure on your hands—making rearranging a breeze.

name: Shine Elevate Chair
